data.name: Savage Diplomacy
data.description: While in humanoid form, a chameleon adept's animal companion grants its master a +%1 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks. Savage diplomacy functions only as long as the creature being influenced can see both the companion and the master.|MIN(6,2+((HunterLVL-1)/4))
